Class SbxPreflight

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx.SbxPreflight
public final class SbxPreflight extends Object
Checks, without changing anything the demo depends on, that this host can run what the adapters will ask of it: sbx is installed and new enough for the cloud, the local daemon is healthy, and the agent has a credential in each location. The answer is cached briefly so a health endpoint can call it freely.

A secret being listed does not mean it works (a stale one is listed too), so an optional probe runs one trivial agent turn in a throwaway sandbox. It costs a few cents and half a minute, so it is off by default and runs once per start, not on every check.
